notes: No more being thrown out of the match by the game's own anti-cheat (controls freeze for 5 s, then the versus menu), which mostly hit players in round 2 after the side swap. Every player in a match needs this version. The game now also writes NoSelfKick.log in the System folder: please send your logs if you see a freeze or a kick, so the real cause can be fixed. Everything from x68 stays.
